<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two peaks), and 127.40 (two peaks) fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). That accounts for 6 aromatic carbons. The remaining peak at 168.20 ppm is outside this range (likely a carbonyl carbon). Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
